# Vendored

`tomli/`: [tomli](https://github.com/hukkin/tomli) 2.2.1, MIT (`tomli/LICENSE`), the TOML
reader that became Python 3.11's `tomllib`. `office` uses `tomllib` when Python has it and this
copy when it does not: macOS ships Python 3.9.

Taken unchanged from `tomli-2.2.1-py3-none-any.whl` on PyPI, sha256
`cb55c73c5f4408779d0cf3eef9f762b9c9f147a77de7b258bef0a5628adc85cc`, without `py.typed`.
